payload.core_mechanism_summary: Direct case-insensitive string comparison: convert to lowercase and check equality with 'yes'.
payload.rationale: The solution performs a trivial string operation per test case without any search, enumeration, or exploration of a state space. None of the candidate subtypes (backtracking, bitmask, branch-and-bound, DFS/BFS, permutation enumeration) are relevant, but we must pick a candidate; 'search_backtracking' is selected as the least inappropriate default, with minimal confidence.
